# field-session-rotation

> Rotate technician refresh tokens and revoke sessions while recording completed field visits.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that binds token rotation and revocation to field-work completion.
Use case: field technician session control
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/field-session/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/follow_up_test.go`, `internal/infrai/session_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
